summary: Creates a group visibility filter in the account. Requires account admin privileges. Set
description: Creates a group visibility filter in the account. Requires account admin privileges. Set ``principal_type`` to ``GROUP`` and specify exactly one of ``exact`` (external ID), ``prefix`` (display-name starts with), or ``regex`` (full RE2 display-name match). The filter applies across all workspaces in the account. A duplicate filter ID or an existing rule with the same type and match value returns ``ALREADY_EXISTS``. Filters are immutable; to change a rule, delete it and create a new one.  :param parent: str   Required. The parent account. Format: accounts/{account_id} :param identity_visibility_filter: :class:`IdentityVisibilityFilter`   Required. The filter to create. Set ``principal_type`` to ``GROUP`` and specify exactly one of   ``exact``, ``prefix``, or ``regex``. The server assigns the resource name; any supplied ``name`` is   ignored. :param identity_visibility_filter_id: str (optional)   Optional. The ID to use for the filter, which becomes the final component of its resource name. If   not specified or empty, the server generates one. Must not contain ``/``.  :returns: :class:`IdentityVisibilityFilter`

description: Lists group visibility filters in the account, returning one page per call. Requires account admin privileges. Returns filter rules, not the groups matched by those rules. To retrieve the next page, pass the response's ``next_page_token`` as ``page_token`` in the next request. If ``next_page_token`` is omitted, there are no more pages.  :param parent: str   Required. The parent account. Format: accounts/{account_id} :param page_size: int (optional)   The maximum number of filters to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If omitted or   non-positive, defaults to 100. Values above 1000 are reduced to 1000. :param page_token: str (optional)   A page token, received from a previous ListIdentityVisibilityFilters call. Provide this to retrieve   the subsequent page.  :returns: Iterator over :class:`IdentityVisibilityFilter`
